summary: The 5 brief-enumerated break-OK changes (#1331 SnapshotBlob v1->v2, #1339 DSL Diagnostic/CompileError reshape, #1341 from_bytes_for_test->from_raw_bytes, #1342 0x647c codepoint mint + DslIoError mirror, #1344 RestrictedSpec/KeyMaterial renames + EncryptionClass + non_exhaustive sweep) are each verified landed-as-described and Ben-conscious (P-III no-users-yet override / pre-v1-API-shape ratification / night-shift surface-arch decisions). The orchestrator's 2-planner triage arbitration is internally consistent with the §1.A.FROZEN spec. HOWEVER three substantive gaps surface vs the L18 charter: (1) MAJOR — V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md item 1 (§8-A visibility cluster) is documented as LANDED with file:line citations to pub(crate) tightened/renamed methods, but at HEAD the methods (get_node / put_node / get_node_label_only / resolve_subgraph_cid_for_test) are STILL pub fn, STILL named the old names, and the cargo-public-api baseline (line 425/426/428/462) still exposes them — the contract narrative and the as-built state are inconsistent (the commit body acknowledges 1.a/1.b/1.c as 'NAMED to follow-up' but the item 1 prose reads as a closed freeze, not a partial-freeze). (2) MAJOR — the brief enumerates 5 break-OK changes but does NOT enumerate (a) #1338 G-CORE-8 ManifestEnvelopeRecheckOutcome NotApplicable->UnresolvedDeny rename + 3 new CapabilityPolicy hooks + soft-seal addition, (b) the G-CORE-10 PR-B StreamHandle.next sync->async migration ratified in V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md item 10, (c) #1310 G-CORE-0 module_ecosystem::install_plugin* deletion (which IS in V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md item 7 but not in the L18 ledger-enumerate list), (d) #1238 COLLAPSE P0+P1 DeviceRevocation deletion + Acceptor demotion + #1271 chain-validation seam consolidation + #1295 P-II workspace-wide to_canonical_bytes/ChangeEvent::minimal rename + #1299 napi PR-A — all are pre-Phase-4-Meta-Core-opening commits in the merged range 8141b94..8cc4eddd that the brief explicitly requires walking ('everything since the phase opened post-Phase-4-Foundation-tag'). (3) MINOR — there is NO consolidated phase-4-meta-core-breaking-changes.md catalog OR equivalent v1-beta release-notes draft; the catalog lives in per-commit-message form + V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md item-by-item prose, which makes the v1-beta release-notes job nontrivial. The L18 readiness charter explicitly asks 'Net catalog of breaking changes ready for the v1-beta release notes?' — answer: NO, not in a single consolidated form. RECOMMENDATION: author docs/V1-BETA-BREAKING-CHANGES.md as a one-pass consolidation of every break-OK change in the merged range (covers everything below: brief's enumerated 5 + the additional 8+ identified here) AND reconcile V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md item 1 narrative with the as-built state (either tighten the §8-A surface in this wave's follow-up OR retense item 1's prose to read PARTIAL-LANDED with the explicit follow-up wave named, NOT post-tighten as-frozen).
